title: LORE: Jointly Learning the Intrinsic Dimensionality and Relative Similarity Structure From Ordinal Data
abstract: arXiv:2602.04192v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning the intrinsic dimensionality of subjective perceptual spaces such as taste, smell, or aesthetics from ordinal data is a challenging problem. We introduce LORE (Low Rank Ordinal Embedding), a scalable framework that jointly learns both the intrinsic dimensionality and an ordinal embedding from noisy triplet comparisons of the form, "Is A more similar to B than C?". Unlike existing methods that require the embedding dimension to be set apriori, LORE regularizes the solution using the nonconvex Schatten-$p$ quasi norm, enabling automatic joint recovery of both the ordinal embedding and its dimensionality. We optimize this joint objective via an iteratively reweighted algorithm and establish convergence guarantees. translated_title: LORE：从序数数据中联合学习内在维度与相对相似性结构
translated_abstract: 从味觉、嗅觉或美学等主观感知空间的序数数据中学习内在维度是一个具有挑战性的问题。我们提出了LORE（低秩序数嵌入），这是一个可扩展的框架，能够从形如“A与B的相似度是否高于A与C？”的含噪三元组比较中，联合学习内在维度和序数嵌入。与现有需要预先设定嵌入维度的方法不同，LORE使用非凸的Schatten-p拟范数对解进行正则化，从而能够自动地联合恢复序数嵌入及其维度。我们通过迭代重加权算法优化这一联合目标函数，并建立了收敛性保证。在合成数据集、模拟感知空间和真实世界众包序数判断上的大量实验表明，LORE能够学习到紧凑、可解释且高度精确的低维嵌入。
tldr: LORE是一个可扩展框架，利用非凸Schatten-p拟范数正则化，从含噪三元组比较中自动联合学习序数嵌入及其内在维度，无需预先设定嵌入维度。
